attributes.visState:
{"aggs":[],"params":{"fontSize":11,"markdown":"### AdGuard Home DNS Detection｜AdGuard Home DNS 偵測套組

`jt-adguard` · rules 130900-130999｜規則 130900-130999

依清單類別（威脅、規避過濾、動態 DNS、rebinding、常被濫用的頂級網域、新註冊網域、廣告）分級 AdGuard Home 的封鎖，回報每個用戶端第一次查詢威脅或規避網域，可選擇分級放行的查詢（OAST 回呼、挖礦礦池、通道服務、Tor、DNS 通道），並分級網頁介面登入、有漏洞的版本、過濾清單濫用與設定變更。

Grades AdGuard Home blocks by list (threat, filter bypass, dynamic DNS, rebinding, abused TLDs, new domains, ads), reports the first lookup of a threat or bypass domain by each client, optionally grades allowed queries (OAST callbacks, mining pools, tunnels, Tor, DNS tunnelling), and grades web interface logins, vulnerable versions, filter-list abuse and configuration changes.

Discover query｜在 Discover 使用的查詢:

`rule.id:[130900 TO 130999] AND rule.id:/[0-9]{6}/`","openLinksInNewTab":false},"title":"jt-adguard · About｜說明","type":"markdown"}
